raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Run native pytest/Testmon selection on CPU runners inside the same CUDA CI image before allocating a GPU job. A successful empty selection skips the GPU job immediately; a nonempty selection executes its exact native node IDs on the existing GPU runner. Failed collection or invalid/missing selection evidence retains native GPU selection and full-bucket fallback.

Reuse the existing selector, recipe rank counts, production/experimental filters, mandatory mappings, baseline compatibility checks, and runner routing. CPU containers use the ordinary Docker runtime without GPU requests. H100 uses the existing AWS/GCP x86 CPU runners; GB200 uses the existing ARM64 CPU runner. Keep the gzip cache version compatible with the current GPU-produced baselines.

The handoff helper only serializes and validates native results and their baseline snapshot, bound to the source SHA, bucket, platform, recipe rank count, and immutable image ID. It does not implement dependency selection or read dependency fingerprints. The native `testmon_selector.py` engine is unchanged. Empty selections export an empty coverage database so the current coverage gate remains effective. Merge-group/full-test policies and baseline production remain unchanged.

This enables CPU-driven skipping directly, without a comparison mode or rollout controls. Hardware-dependent collection can differ on CPU despite using the same image; collection errors fall back to GPU testing, while successful CPU selections are used as requested.

Validation: 342 targeted regression tests passed, covering native collection, empty GPU skipping, CPU failures, artifact identity and completeness, recipe topology, immutable image execution, GPU fallback, coverage, and cache compression. Formatting, Ruff, pylint, targeted typing, Bash syntax, and reusable-workflow Actionlint checks passed. The main workflow retains its existing unrelated missing-required-script diagnostics. A local CUDA-base-container probe confirmed CUDA libraries are present with zero visible GPUs; actual H100/GB200 CPU collection and GPU execution are pending CI.

## Code provenance

Original changes using existing repository code; no external code copied or adapted.

### [P2] Install Testmon before preparing the GPU handoff

A valid nonempty CPU selection cannot bypass GPU collection when the fresh GPU container lacks `pytest-testmon`. In [run_enforced_tests](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/9f4b49096735a486b589a67e6cd1fe029928a8f9/tests/unit_tests/run_ci_test.sh#L375-L386), `preselected` calls `prepare --check-runtime` before reaching the plugin installation in [run_testmon_phase](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/9f4b49096735a486b589a67e6cd1fe029928a8f9/tests/unit_tests/run_ci_test.sh#L232-L248). Preparation validates the runtime, and [runtime_identity](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/9f4b49096735a486b589a67e6cd1fe029928a8f9/tests/unit_tests/testmon_cache.py#L54-L64) rejects the missing package. The image dependency sync doesn't request the separate [Testmon dependency group](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/9f4b49096735a486b589a67e6cd1fe029928a8f9/pyproject.toml#L149-L168), so this is a supported starting state. The GPU then repeats native selection instead of executing the CPU-selected IDs directly.

**Correction:** Install the pinned plugin before preparation. The invariant is that a valid handoff can bypass GPU selection without depending on an earlier collection process to install its validation prerequisite. Replace the opening condition and success branch at [lines 375–376](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/9f4b49096735a486b589a67e6cd1fe029928a8f9/tests/unit_tests/run_ci_test.sh#L375-L376) with the following, keeping the existing `else` branch:

```bash
    if [[ "$mode" == "preselected" ]] \
        && uv pip install --python /opt/venv/bin/python --no-deps "pytest-testmon==2.2.0" \
        && native_selection_transport prepare; then
        UNIT_TESTMON_INSTALLED=true
        echo "Using the validated native CPU selection."
```

This limits the added installation to `preselected`. Preserve installation during native `enforce` and `select-only` collection, invalid-handoff → native-GPU → full-bucket fallback, phase markers, repeat counts, and executed-test failure propagation. Full and baseline behavior should remain unchanged. Verify this suggested code before adopting it.

**Proposed acceptance checks:** Start a GPU run without Testmon and supply a valid nonempty artifact from the same image and runtime. Assert that installation precedes real preparation, no native selector runs, and the artifact's exact targets execute with the existing phase markers and configured repeat count. Retain cases where an invalid artifact invokes native collection, failed native collection invokes the full bucket, and an executed test failure fails the run. The current [preselected regression test](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/9f4b49096735a486b589a67e6cd1fe029928a8f9/tests/test_utils/test_unit_testmon.py#L726-L767) stubs the transport helper, so it doesn't exercise this prerequisite.

I completed the light source review across the changed files and their directly affected paths. I didn't execute tests or validate the runner behavior.

+

+

+        required: true
+      platform:

+        description: JSON-encoded GPU runner
+        type: string
+        required: true
+      selection-runner:
+        description: JSON-encoded CPU runner with the image's native architecture
+        type: string
+        default: ""
+      container-image:
+        type: string
+        required: true
+      sha:
+        type: string
+        required: true
+      timeout:
+        type: number
+        default: 30
+      unit_testmon_mode:
+        type: string
+        default: full
+      unit_testmon_target_branch:
+        type: string
+        default: ""
+      unit_test_pr_files_artifact_id:

+        default: ""

+  contents: read
+  id-token: write
+

+  select:
+    name: Native Testmon selection on CPU

+      inputs.unit_testmon_mode == 'enforce'
+      && inputs.unit_testmon_target_branch == 'main'
+      && inputs.selection-runner != ''
+      && inputs.bucket != 'tests/unit_tests/inference/test_batch_invariant_fp8.py'
+      && !(startsWith(inputs.bucket, 'tests/unit_tests/inference/') && contains(inputs.bucket, '/test_disagg_'))

+    timeout-minutes: 30

+        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ inputs.sha }}
+
+      - name: Configure GAR Docker authentication
+        if: startsWith(inputs.container-image, 'asia-southeast1-docker.pkg.dev/')
+        continue-on-error: true
+        shell: bash -e -u -o pipefail {0}
+        env:
+          CONTAINER_IMAGE: ${{ inputs.container-image }}
+        run: |
+          GAR_HOST="${CONTAINER_IMAGE%%/*}"
+          docker-credential-gcr configure-docker --registries="$GAR_HOST"
+          docker-credential-gcr get <<< "https://$GAR_HOST" >/dev/null
+
+      - name: Login to ECR
+        if: contains(inputs.container-image, '.dkr.ecr.')
+        continue-on-error: true
+        uses: aws-actions/amazon-ecr-login@03f1aad4c6c7ffd436567f42f9384779290529bd # v2.1.7
+        env:
+          AWS_REGION: ${{ inputs.platform == 'dgx_gb200' && 'us-east-2' || 'us-east-1' }}
+
+      - name: Match the GPU baseline cache compression
+        id: cache-compression
+        continue-on-error: true
+        shell: bash -e -u -o pipefail {0}

+          # The existing GPU baseline namespace uses gzip; CPU runners may have zstd.
+          TESTMON_CACHE_BIN=$(mktemp -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/unit-testmon-gzip.XXXXXX")

+        id: selection
+        continue-on-error: true
+        timeout-minutes: 20
+        uses: ./.github/actions

+          script: ""
+          test_case: ${{ inputs.bucket }}
+          tag: latest
+          timeout: "15"
+          is_unit_test: "true"
+          container-image: ${{ inputs.container-image }}
+          platform: ${{ inputs.platform }}

+# Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+
+"""Transport native pytest/Testmon selections without deciding dependencies."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import shutil
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from testmon_cache import PHASES, cache_identity, validate_cache, validate_phase
+
+SCHEMA = 1
+SELECTION = "selection.json"
+SNAPSHOT_FILES = (
+    "manifest.json",
+    "changed-files",
+    *(f"{phase}/{filename}" for phase in PHASES for filename in (".testmondata", "metadata.json")),
+)
+
+
+def _digest(path: Path) -> str:
+    with path.open("rb") as stream:
+        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()
+
+
+def _read_json(path: Path) -> dict:
+    value = json.loads(path.read_text())
+    if not isinstance(value, dict):
+        raise ValueError(f"Expected a JSON object in {path}")
+    return value
+
+
+def _targets(value: object) -> list[str]:
+    """Reject malformed transport entries before using them as pytest arguments."""
+    if not isinstance(value, list) or not all(isinstance(item, str) for item in value):
+        raise ValueError("Selected tests must be a list of strings")
+    if value != sorted(set(value)):
+        raise ValueError("Selected tests must be sorted and unique")
+    for nodeid in value:
+        filename = nodeid.split("::", 1)[0]
+        path = Path(filename)
+        if (
+            not filename.startswith("tests/unit_tests/")
+            or path.suffix != ".py"
+            or ".." in path.parts
+            or any(char in nodeid for char in "\r\n\0")
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(f"Invalid selected test: {nodeid!r}")
+    return value
+
+
+def _read_targets(path: Path) -> list[str]:
+    return _targets(path.read_text().splitlines())
+
+
+def _merged(ranks: dict[str, list[str]], mandatory: list[str]) -> list[str]:
+    # The existing mandatory helper replaces individual IDs with whole files.
+    return sorted(
+        {
+            nodeid
+            for ids in ranks.values()
+            for nodeid in ids
+            if nodeid.split("::", 1)[0] not in mandatory
+        }
+        | set(mandatory)
+    )
+
+
+def _phase_outputs(cache_dir: Path, world_size: int) -> dict:
+    phases = {}
+    for phase in PHASES:
+        directory = cache_dir / ".testmon-work" / phase
+        paths = {path.parent.name: path for path in directory.glob("rank-*/selected-tests")}
+        expected = {f"rank-{rank}" for rank in range(world_size)}
+        if paths.keys() != expected:
+            raise ValueError(f"Incomplete native {phase} rank selections: {sorted(paths)}")
+        ranks = {str(rank): _read_targets(paths[f"rank-{rank}"]) for rank in range(world_size)}
+        mandatory = _read_targets(directory / "mandatory-tests")
+        if any("::" in filename for filename in mandatory):
+            raise ValueError("Mandatory entries must be whole test files")
+        selected = _read_targets(directory / "selected-tests")
+        if selected != _merged(ranks, mandatory):
+            raise ValueError(f"Native {phase} union does not match rank and mandatory outputs")
+        phases[phase] = {"selected": selected, "mandatory": mandatory, "ranks": ranks}
+    return phases
+
+
+def _baseline(cache_dir: Path, bucket: str, platform: str, check_runtime: bool) -> str:
+    identity = cache_identity(Path.cwd(), bucket, platform)
+    manifest = _read_json(cache_dir / "manifest.json")
+    key = identity["cache_prefix"] + manifest["generation"]
+    if os.environ.get("UNIT_TESTMON_CACHE_KEY", key) != key:
+        raise ValueError("Native selection does not match the restored cache key")
+    validate_cache(cache_dir, identity, key)
+    if check_runtime:
+        for phase in PHASES:
+            validate_phase(cache_dir, phase, check_runtime=True)
+    return key
+
+
+def _identity(source_sha: str, image_id: str, world_size: int) -> None:
+    if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", source_sha):
+        raise ValueError("Selection source SHA must be a full commit ID")
+    if not re.fullmatch(r"sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}", image_id):
+        raise ValueError("Selection requires an immutable Docker image ID")
+    if type(world_size) is not int or world_size < 1:
+        raise ValueError("Selection world size must be a positive integer")
+
+
+def export_selection(
+    cache_dir: Path, bucket: str, platform: str, source_sha: str, image_id: str, world_size: int
+) -> dict:
+    """Export successful native results; callers must check every collection process first."""
+    _identity(source_sha, image_id, world_size)
+    key = _baseline(cache_dir, bucket, platform, check_runtime=True)
+    selection = {
+        "schema": SCHEMA,
+        "complete": True,
+        "source_sha": source_sha,
+        "bucket": bucket,
+        "platform": platform,
+        "image_id": image_id,
+        "world_size": world_size,
+        "cache_key": key,
+        "snapshot": {name: _digest(cache_dir / name) for name in SNAPSHOT_FILES},
+        "phases": _phase_outputs(cache_dir, world_size),
+    }
+    (cache_dir / SELECTION).write_text(json.dumps(selection, indent=2) + "\n")
+    return selection
+
+
+def validate_selection(
+    cache_dir: Path,
+    bucket: str,
+    platform: str,
+    source_sha: str,
+    image_id: str,
+    world_size: int | None = None,
+    *,
+    check_runtime: bool = False,
+) -> dict:
+    """Validate identity, baseline snapshot, and completeness without selecting any tests."""
+    selection = _read_json(cache_dir / SELECTION)
+    size = selection["world_size"]
+    _identity(source_sha, image_id, size)
+    if (
+        type(selection["schema"]) is not int
+        or selection["schema"] != SCHEMA
+        or selection["complete"] is not True
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Incomplete or unsupported native selection artifact")
+    if any(
+        selection[name] != expected
+        for name, expected in {
+            "source_sha": source_sha,
+            "bucket": bucket,
+            "platform": platform,
+            "image_id": image_id,
+        }.items()
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Native selection does not match this checkout, image, or bucket")
+    if world_size is not None and size != world_size:
+        raise ValueError("Native selection recipe world size changed")
+    if selection["snapshot"] != {name: _digest(cache_dir / name) for name in SNAPSHOT_FILES}:
+        raise ValueError("Native selection baseline snapshot changed")
+    if selection["cache_key"] != _baseline(cache_dir, bucket, platform, check_runtime):
+        raise ValueError("Native selection cache generation changed")
+    phases = selection["phases"]
+    if not isinstance(phases, dict):
+        raise ValueError("Native selection phases must be an object")
+    if set(phases) != set(PHASES):
+        raise ValueError("Native selection is missing a phase")
+    for phase in PHASES:
+        output = phases[phase]
+        if not isinstance(output, dict) or not isinstance(output.get("ranks"), dict):
+            raise ValueError("Native phase and rank selections must be objects")
+        ranks = output["ranks"]
+        if set(ranks) != {str(rank) for rank in range(size)}:
+            raise ValueError(f"Native {phase} selection is missing ranks")
+        for ids in ranks.values():
+            _targets(ids)
+        mandatory = _targets(output["mandatory"])
+        if any("::" in filename for filename in mandatory):
+            raise ValueError("Mandatory entries must be whole test files")
+        if _targets(output["selected"]) != _merged(ranks, mandatory):
+            raise ValueError(f"Native {phase} selection union changed")
+    return selection
+
+
+def prepare_selection(cache_dir: Path, selection: dict) -> None:
+    """Expose previously validated native IDs to the existing GPU execution harness."""
+    work = cache_dir / ".testmon-work"
+    if work.exists():
+        shutil.rmtree(work)
+    for phase in PHASES:
+        directory = work / phase
+        directory.mkdir(parents=True)
+        for filename, field in (("selected-tests", "selected"), ("mandatory-tests", "mandatory")):
+            directory.joinpath(filename).write_text(
+                "".join(f"{nodeid}\n" for nodeid in selection["phases"][phase][field])
+            )
+
+
+def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("command", choices=("export", "validate", "prepare"))
+    parser.add_argument("--cache-dir", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--bucket", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--platform", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--source-sha", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--image-id", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--world-size", type=int)
+    parser.add_argument("--check-runtime", action="store_true")
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+    try:
+        if args.command != "validate" and args.world_size is None:
+            raise ValueError("Container collection/execution requires the actual recipe world size")
+        values = (
+            args.cache_dir,
+            args.bucket,
+            args.platform,
+            args.source_sha,
+            args.image_id,
+            args.world_size,
+        )
+        if args.command == "export":
+            selection = export_selection(*values)
+        else:
+            selection = validate_selection(*values, check_runtime=args.check_runtime)
+            if args.command == "prepare":
+                prepare_selection(args.cache_dir, selection)
+        print(f"has_tests={str(any(p['selected'] for p in selection['phases'].values())).lower()}")
+        print(f"cache_key={selection['cache_key']}")
+        return 0
+    except (OSError, RuntimeError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError) as error:
+        print(f"Native Testmon selection unavailable: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

### [P2] Install Testmon before preparing the GPU handoff

A valid nonempty CPU selection cannot bypass GPU collection when the fresh GPU container lacks `pytest-testmon`. In [run_enforced_tests](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/9f4b49096735a486b589a67e6cd1fe029928a8f9/tests/unit_tests/run_ci_test.sh#L375-L386), `preselected` calls `prepare --check-runtime` before reaching the plugin installation in [run_testmon_phase](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/9f4b49096735a486b589a67e6cd1fe029928a8f9/tests/unit_tests/run_ci_test.sh#L232-L248). Preparation validates the runtime, and [runtime_identity](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/9f4b49096735a486b589a67e6cd1fe029928a8f9/tests/unit_tests/testmon_cache.py#L54-L64) rejects the missing package. The image dependency sync doesn't request the separate [Testmon dependency group](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/9f4b49096735a486b589a67e6cd1fe029928a8f9/pyproject.toml#L149-L168), so this is a supported starting state. The GPU then repeats native selection instead of executing the CPU-selected IDs directly.

**Correction:** Install the pinned plugin before preparation. The invariant is that a valid handoff can bypass GPU selection without depending on an earlier collection process to install its validation prerequisite. Replace the opening condition and success branch at [lines 375–376](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/9f4b49096735a486b589a67e6cd1fe029928a8f9/tests/unit_tests/run_ci_test.sh#L375-L376) with the following, keeping the existing `else` branch:

```bash
    if [[ "$mode" == "preselected" ]] \
        && uv pip install --python /opt/venv/bin/python --no-deps "pytest-testmon==2.2.0" \
        && native_selection_transport prepare; then
        UNIT_TESTMON_INSTALLED=true
        echo "Using the validated native CPU selection."
```

This limits the added installation to `preselected`. Preserve installation during native `enforce` and `select-only` collection, invalid-handoff → native-GPU → full-bucket fallback, phase markers, repeat counts, and executed-test failure propagation. Full and baseline behavior should remain unchanged. Verify this suggested code before adopting it.

**Proposed acceptance checks:** Start a GPU run without Testmon and supply a valid nonempty artifact from the same image and runtime. Assert that installation precedes real preparation, no native selector runs, and the artifact's exact targets execute with the existing phase markers and configured repeat count. Retain cases where an invalid artifact invokes native collection, failed native collection invokes the full bucket, and an executed test failure fails the run. The current [preselected regression test](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/9f4b49096735a486b589a67e6cd1fe029928a8f9/tests/test_utils/test_unit_testmon.py#L726-L767) stubs the transport helper, so it doesn't exercise this prerequisite.

I completed the light source review across the changed files and their directly affected paths. I didn't execute tests or validate the runner behavior.
